basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old linguistics enthusiast from Portland, Oregon who spends most evenings exploring the roots of words and the intricacies of language. Works as a freelance writer, primarily focusing on educational content. Enjoys deep dives into conspiracy theories during late-night Reddit scrolls. Recently engaged, with plans for a budget-friendly wedding. Usually online during evenings and late nights, often accompanied by a cup of herbal tea.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a Bachelor's degree in Linguistics from a local university. Developed a strong interest in etymology during college and continued exploring this passion through self-study and online courses. Also dabbles in data science concepts, inspired by participation in Numerai competitions.
